feature: The Text section's Font, Size and Weight menus wear the panel's dropdown
summary: Font, Size and Weight in the Text section (and a Captions layer's Text section) are now the same drawn dropdown as Fade In, Curve and every other menu in the panel, instead of small system pop-ups with up and down arrows.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the sample recording, add a title with the Text tool, pick it.

try.do: Before: the Text section's menus were narrower grey pop-ups with up and down arrows under the Time section's chevron dropdowns.
Pick a title and scroll the panel to Time and Text: Font, Size and Weight now match Fade In in height, fill, chevron and where the value sits.
Switch the Mac to Light and look again.
Click anywhere on the Font box, including near its left and right ends, and pick Georgia: the menu hangs from the box and the title changes; Cmd-Z puts it back in one step.
Pick two text layers of different sizes: Size reads Mixed, dimmed, and the open menu ticks nothing.
Set a text in Bodoni 72 Smallcaps and rest the pointer on Font: the box cuts the name with an ellipsis and the tip spells it in full.

evaluate: Does the Text section now read as part of the same panel as the Time section?
Is the dimmed Mixed in the Size box clear enough in both light and dark?
Is a full-width Size box right for a value as short as 48 px, or would you rather it be narrow?
Does the open menu hanging from the box's left edge feel right for a list of fonts?
rough: The video title mock (video-title-wt.html, Text section) draws Size as a box you type a number into, beside Weight; the app still offers Size as a dropdown of preset sizes on its own row. Filed as a-title-s-size-is-a-number-you-type-or-nudge-the.

Blending and Masked by in Appearance, and menus in the Effects list such as a shadow's Kind, are still system pop-ups right under the Text section. Filed as the-appearance-and-effects-menus-wear-the-same-d.
The Font list shows every family in the system font, not in its own face; that is unchanged from before.
The text tool's own options popover still uses system pop-ups for Font, Size and Weight; it is a different surface and was left alone.
Current's Text section shares this code, so it gets the same face; Size and Weight there keep their two columns and were checked in a picture.
